add_expense:
(define (add_expense amount [category 'null] [note 'null])
  (unless (real? amount) (error 'add_expense "amount must be a number"))
  (unless (> amount 0) (error 'add_expense "amount must be positive"))
  (unless (and (string? category) (not (equal? category ""))) (error 'add_expense "category must be a non-empty string"))
  (unless (or (eq? note 'null) (string? note)) (error 'add_expense "note must be a string"))
  (let* ([s (get-state)]
         [es (hash-ref s 'expenses '())]
         [e (if (eq? note 'null)
                (hasheq 'amount amount 'category category)
                (hasheq 'amount amount 'category category 'note note))])
    (set-state! (hash-set s 'expenses (append es (list e))))
    (length (hash-ref (get-state) 'expenses '()))))
by_category:
(define (by_category)
  (let ([es (hash-ref (get-state) 'expenses '())])
    (for/fold ([acc (hasheq)]) ([e es])
      (let* ([raw (hash-ref e 'category "uncategorized")]
             [k (string->symbol (if (string? raw) raw (format "~a" raw)))]
             [cur (hash-ref acc k 0)])
        (hash-set acc k (+ cur (/ (expense_cents e) 100)))))))
over_budget:
(define (over_budget)
  (define (cents_of v)
    (if (real? v) (inexact->exact (round (* 100 v))) 0))
  (define (spent_by_category)
    (for/fold ([acc (hasheq)]) ([e (hash-ref (get-state) 'expenses '())])
      (let* ([raw (hash-ref e 'category "uncategorized")]
             [k (string->symbol (if (string? raw) raw (format "~a" raw)))]
             [cur (hash-ref acc k 0)])
        (hash-set acc k (+ cur (expense_cents e))))))
  (let* ([b0 (hash-ref (get-state) 'budgets (hasheq))]
         [bs (if (hash? b0) b0 (hasheq))]
         [sp (spent_by_category)])
    (sort (for/list ([k (in-hash-keys bs)]
                     #:when (> (hash-ref sp k 0) (cents_of (hash-ref bs k 0))))
            (symbol->string k))
          string<?)))
set_budget:
(define (set_budget category amount)
  (unless (real? amount) (error 'set_budget "amount must be a number"))
  (unless (>= amount 0) (error 'set_budget "amount must not be negative"))
  (unless (string? category) (error 'set_budget "category must be a string"))
  (let* ([s (get-state)]
         [b0 (hash-ref s 'budgets (hasheq))]
         [bs (if (hash? b0) b0 (hasheq))]
         [k (string->symbol category)]
         [c (inexact->exact (round (* 100 amount)))])
    (set-state! (hash-set s 'budgets (hash-set bs k (/ c 100))))
    (/ c 100)))
top_category:
(define (top_category)
  (let* ([es (hash-ref (get-state) 'expenses '())]
         [sp (for/fold ([acc (hasheq)]) ([e es])
               (let* ([raw (hash-ref e 'category "uncategorized")]
                      [k (string->symbol (if (string? raw) raw (format "~a" raw)))]
                      [cur (hash-ref acc k 0)])
                 (hash-set acc k (+ cur (expense_cents e)))))])
    (if (zero? (hash-count sp))
        'null
        (last (sort (for/list ([k (in-hash-keys sp)]) (symbol->string k))
                    (lambda (a b)
                      (let ([ca (hash-ref sp (string->symbol a) 0)]
                            [cb (hash-ref sp (string->symbol b) 0)])
                        (cond [(< ca cb) #t]
                              [(> ca cb) #f]
                              [else (string>? a b)]))))))))
